screen.spirit_form.title: Spirit Form
screen.spirit_form.wheel.empty: No unlocked abilities on this page

screen.spirit_form.loadout.hint2: Right click clears a slot, clicking the bottom row puts an ability back.
screen.spirit_form.shards.desc: How many Soul Shards can exist simultaneously. Without Shards, items are not preserved after death. The N-th Shard costs N levels.
screen.spirit_form.ability.requirement_r: Reward for King of the Beyond
screen.spirit_form.army.confirm: Click again to delete the soul

screen.spirit_form.army.sector.orders.de: Choose how your souls behave in combat.
screen.spirit_form.army.sector.delete.de: Permanently delete a soul from storage. Needs confirmation.
screen.spirit_form.army.hint.main: Left click - select · Right click - close
screen.spirit_form.army.hint.summon: Left click - summon or recall · Shift+Right click - icon · Right click - back

screen.spirit_form.army_slots.desc: How many souls the Army of the Beyond can store. You start with one slot; each next slot costs as many experience levels as the slots you already have.
screen.spirit_form.next.cost: The next level costs %s experience levels
screen.spirit_form.path.hunger.desc: How much hunger the Spirit spends while flying. The higher the level, the lower the cost.
screen.spirit_form.path.movement.desc: Flight speed in Spirit Form. The higher the level, the faster you fly.
screen.spirit_form.path.darkness.desc: How long Darkness lasts in the form and after leaving it. At high levels it disappears entirely.
screen.spirit_form.abilities.desc: Separate Spirit abilities: each is unlocked with experience levels and requires certain path levels.
screen.spirit_form.bar.aux.desc: Abilities triggered with the number keys. Passive abilities can go here too: the key toggles them.
screen.spirit_form.bar.main.desc: Main abilities: each has its own hotkey. Passive abilities can go here too: the key toggles them.
screen.spirit_form.bar.how: Open the bar, pick up an ability with a click and drop it into the cell you want.
screen.spirit_form.hint: Arrows: select · Enter: confirm · Mouse wheel: scroll
hud.spirit_form.herald.title: Pursuit
stat.spirit_form.darkness.constant: Constant Darkness in form; after leaving: %s s
stat.spirit_form.darkness.constant_none: Constant Darkness in form; none after leaving
stat.spirit_form.darkness.temp: Darkness after entering the form: %s s
stat.spirit_form.darkness.highlight: No Darkness; mobs within %s blocks are highlighted
ability.spirit_form.sense.desc: Highlights nearby mobs and storages (chests, barrels). Details in the Diary of My Death.
ability.spirit_form.vanish.desc: Mobs stop noticing you. Toggled on and off with the same key, with no time limit.
ability.spirit_form.possession.desc: Enter a mob and control its body.
ability.spirit_form.touch.desc: Lift a mob into the air and hurl it away.
ability.spirit_form.delirium.desc: A smoke decoy distracts mobs while you turn invisible.
ability.spirit_form.icy_touch.desc: Freezes mobs, water and lava around you.
ability.spirit_form.presence.desc: Peaceful mobs flee, hostile ones attack.
ability.spirit_form.life_gift.desc: Charge costs hearts: the ball heals a mob.
ability.spirit_form.scales.desc: Charge costs hearts: the ball hurts a mob.
ability.spirit_form.gaze.desc: Hostile mobs flee, peaceful ones come to you.
ability.spirit_form.echo.desc: Leaves an echo. Deactivation returns to it.
ability.spirit_form.scream.desc: Mobs nearby turn to your side.
ability.spirit_form.summon.desc: Teleports the entity you are looking at to you.
ability.spirit_form.army.desc: Reward for the advancement "King of the Beyond". Souls of slain creatures become your army. In ability mode (%s) activate this ability to open the Army wheel: the centre summons all souls or returns them to storage, and around it are Summon, Orders and Delete. Right click goes back.
ability.spirit_form.energy.desc: Reward for the "Lord of the Beyond" advancement. Twice the health, an Army twice as strong and sturdy. Toggled on the wheel (%s).
order.spirit_form.guard.desc: Souls stay close and attack whoever hurts you.
order.spirit_form.hold.desc: Souls stay in place and attack anyone who comes near.
order.spirit_form.retreat.desc: All souls return to the storage.
order.spirit_form.fury.desc: Guard and attack combined: souls hit both whoever hurts you and whoever you hit. Once in a fight, they finish it.
tooltip.spirit_form.bracelet.1: Speed, strength, and jump x2, abilities recover twice as fast. Inverts skin colors.
tooltip.spirit_form.artifact.movement: Artifact of the Path of Movement
tooltip.spirit_form.catcher.empty: Empty. Right click a mob to catch it.
tooltip.spirit_form.necklace.1: While worn, hunger is not spent.
tooltip.spirit_form.artifact.hunger: Artifact of the Path of Hunger
tooltip.spirit_form.soul_plunder.1: All experience you gain is multiplied by five.
tooltip.spirit_form.soul_plunder.2: Works in a hand, in the leggings slot or in a vault cell.
tooltip.spirit_form.shackles.1: The range of abilities is doubled.
tooltip.spirit_form.shackles.2: Worn as boots or placed in the vault.
tooltip.spirit_form.artifact.darkness: Artifact of the Path of Darkness
item.spirit_form.herald_heart.tooltip: Right-click: consume, pursuit meter -100. Three different hearts merge into the Heart of Death.
item.spirit_form.death_heart.tooltip: In Spirit Form, use it on an Echo of the Beyond block to summon the Herald of Death.
item.spirit_form.death_heart.tooltip2: Forever: abilities recharge twice as fast, hunger drains half as much, twice the Soul Shards and Army slots.
item.spirit_form.crystal_soul.tooltip: A soul frozen in amethyst. A crafting material.
item.spirit_form.proof_of_strength.toolt: In Spirit Form, use it on an Echo of the Beyond block to summon the Herald of Death.
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.heal: Heals %s-%s%% of damage dealt and half a hunger icon per hit (no effect on undead and golems)
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.charge_how: Charge is gained instead of a soul, when one would appear
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.freeze: Right click: a mint smoke circle (%s blocks) freezes mobs for %s s, strength x%s
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.reaper: Full charge and full set: right click starts Reaping (hits are lethal)
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.no_form: Spirit invulnerability does not work while holding it
tooltip.spirit_form.crown: Gaze from the Void: shows health and effects of the creature you look at
tooltip.spirit_form.cloak: Edge: first damage after leaving Spirit Form is ignored, first hit after entering it is x10; form cooldown %s s
tooltip.spirit_form.trousers: Elusiveness: after a kill, move twice as fast for %s s
tooltip.spirit_form.boots: Trail: after a kill, leave soul fire behind for %s s; fire does not hurt you
tooltip.spirit_form.set: Full set: Reaper of the Beyond (souls always appear)
spirit_form.configuration.title: Spirit Form Settings
spirit_form.configuration.invisibilityDu: How many seconds the invisibility granted by Delirium lasts. Vanish itself has no duration: the player toggles it.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityHungerC: How many hunger points invisibility and teleportation cost per use.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCooldow: Cooldown of invisibility and teleportation, in seconds.
spirit_form.configuration.highlightRadiu: Radius in which mobs are highlighted at Darkness level 15.
spirit_form.configuration.levelCosts.too: 15 numbers: experience level cost of upgrade levels 1-15. The first is unlocking the form (level 1), the rest are levels 2-15 of every branch.
spirit_form.configuration.possessRange.t: Maximum distance from which a mob can be possessed.
spirit_form.configuration.teleportSmokeS: For how many seconds extra smoke surrounds the player after a teleport.
spirit_form.configuration.formCooldownSe: Seconds before you can become a Spirit again after draining a possessed mob.
spirit_form.configuration.instinctHunger: How many hunger points one use of Spirit Instinct costs (2 points = one drumstick).
spirit_form.configuration.touchRange.too: How far a mob can be grabbed (blocks).
spirit_form.configuration.touchThrowPowe: Speed a mob is hurled with when the key is released.
spirit_form.configuration.touchImpactDam: Damage per unit of speed when a thrown mob hits a block.
spirit_form.configuration.deliriumDecoyS: How many seconds the decoy stays.
spirit_form.configuration.icyRadius.tool: Water within this radius around the player freezes.
spirit_form.configuration.presenceRadius: Mobs within this radius flee or attack.
spirit_form.configuration.drainHpPerHung: How much mob health becomes one hunger point when leaving the form inside a mob.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityRequire: Spirit Sense, Vanish, Spirit Step and Presence (the last needs all three paths).
Icy Touch, Immunity, Gift of Life, Spirit Gaze (all paths).
spirit_form.configuration.chargeTicks.to: How many ticks to hold the Gift of Life or Scales key to add one unit of charge.
spirit_form.configuration.chargeLimit.to: Optional cap on the charge of Gift of Life and Scales. 0 means no cap: charging stops only when one heart is left.
spirit_form.configuration.chargeRange.to: How far the Gift of Life or Scales ball flies.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityRequire: Path level for the strongest abilities
Possession (all paths), Spirit Touch, Delirium and Scales.
spirit_form.configuration.soulShardLimit: How many Soul Shards a player can have at once. Older ones vanish.
Give the Diary of My Death (needs Patchouli) when the Spirit Form is unlocked.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostBas: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostAdv: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostMas: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityRequire: Required path level for Death's Abode, Spirit Scream, and Summon.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostNov: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.screamRadius.t: Within what radius (blocks) mobs turn to the player.
spirit_form.configuration.screamDuration: How many seconds mobs stay on the player's side.
spirit_form.configuration.summonRange.to: How far (blocks) the Summon ability reaches the entity you are looking at.
spirit_form.configuration.touchBlockDama: Damage per unit of speed when a thrown block hits an entity.
spirit_form.configuration.touchBlockMaxH: Blocks harder than this value cannot be lifted (obsidian 50, stone 1.5).
spirit_form.configuration.armyMaxSlots.t: The maximum number of souls that can be stored in the Army Storage.
screen.spirit_form.storage.desc: Artifacts and gear are kept here. Items in cells work as if worn and are not lost on death. New cells unlock for experience levels: the N-th costs N levels.
screen.spirit_form.vault.artifacts.desc: An artifact works while it sits in a cell. One artifact takes one cell, duplicates do not stack. The eye toggles showing it on your character, the power icon turns the item's effect on and off.
screen.spirit_form.vault.gear.desc: Armor in cells is shown on your character (over worn armor; the eye toggles it) and gives its stats when the matching slot is empty. Effects of this mod's items always work. Hands: the Scythe of the Beyond (main) and the Soul Catcher (off hand) work with an empty hand.
screen.spirit_form.vault.locked: Locked cell. Click to unlock for %s experience levels.
screen.spirit_form.vault.eye.shown: Shown on your character. Click to hide.
screen.spirit_form.vault.eye.hidden: Hidden on your character. Click to show.
screen.spirit_form.vault.power.on: Effect on. Click to turn off.
screen.spirit_form.vault.power.off: Effect off. Click to turn on.
screen.spirit_form.vault.hint: Click an inventory item, then a cell. Shift + click puts it in the first free cell. Clicking a filled cell returns the item.
message.spirit_form.vault.combat: You cannot swap vault items during combat.
message.spirit_form.vault.not_allowed: This item does not fit the cell.
message.spirit_form.vault.duplicate: This artifact is already in the vault.
spirit_form.configuration.vaultCombatSec: Seconds after the last hit (dealt or taken) during which items cannot be put into or taken out of the vault. 0 disables the lock.
spirit_form.configuration.armySoulChance: The chance that a slain mob will drop a soul (between 0 and 1). Bosses always drop their souls.
spirit_form.configuration.armyWispSecond: How many seconds a wisp waits before being collected.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheMaxCharg: Maximum charge of the Scythe of the Beyond.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheFreezeRa: Radius of the mint smoke circle that freezes mobs (blocks).
spirit_form.configuration.scytheFreezeSe: Seconds mobs stay frozen and the player stays empowered.
spirit_form.configuration.scythePowerMul: Damage multiplier after using the Scythe.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheLockSeco: Seconds the Scythe cannot gain charge after Reaping.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheHealMinP: Minimum percent of damage dealt that heals the player.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheHealMaxP: Maximum percent of damage dealt that heals the player.
spirit_form.configuration.formEdgeCooldo: Spirit Form cooldown while the Cloak of the Beyond is worn.
spirit_form.configuration.gearPerkSecond: Seconds Elusiveness and Trail last after a kill.
spirit_form.configuration.heraldRadius.t: Radius of the Heralds' special effects (blocks).
spirit_form.configuration.heraldStormWin: Seconds the Storm Herald's wind stops after a Ghost Step.
spirit_form.configuration.heraldDeathHea: Health it regains per point of damage dealt to ordinary creatures.
spirit_form.configuration.heraldProgress: Yes: after a Herald appears, increments start again from +1. No: the entry counter never resets.
spirit_form.diary.desc: Notes from one who died but did not vanish. Here, you will find everything regarding the Ghost form, Paths, abilities, and artifacts.
command.spirit_form.herald.meter: Meter: %s, step %s, entries this cycle %s, total %s, next: %s
command.spirit_form.herald.spawn_failed: Could not create the Herald (one already exists or no room).
message.spirit_form.titan.no_form: The Spirit Form does not work beneath the Titan Tree.
message.spirit_form.mavka.friend: The Mavkas saw you slay the Chuhaister. They will no longer harm you.
message.spirit_form.mavka.blessing: The Mavka thanks you for the Wither Rose and grants you the strength of the forest.
command.spirit_form.locate.wrong_dimensi: The trees exist only in the Beyond: go there first.
command.spirit_form.locate.click: Click to suggest the teleport command
command.spirit_form.locate.titan: Nearest Titan Tree: %s, %s blocks away. It exists only in chunks generated after the update.
command.spirit_form.locate.mavka: Nearest Mavka Tree (probable): %s, %s blocks away. It exists only in forest chunks generated after the update.
message.spirit_form.vodianyk.expel: The Vodianyk pushes you out of Spirit Form!
spirit_form.bestiary.title: Bestiary of the Beyond
spirit_form.bestiary.desc: Notes on the biomes, creatures and Heralds of the Beyond: where to find them, how to deal with them and how to defeat them.
command.spirit_form.unlock.done: Entries unlocked: %s. If the book is open, close and reopen it.
command.spirit_form.unlock.no_player: Only a player can run this command.
screen.spirit_form.intro: Choose a path to upgrade it and unlock its abilities, or choose "Layout" to arrange abilities on the three bars.
screen.spirit_form.legend: In a path list, green names are unlocked abilities and grey names are still locked.
screen.spirit_form.shards.name: Soul Shards
screen.spirit_form.army_slots.name: Army storage
screen.spirit_form.instinct.desc: When your health drops to one heart or a hit would be lethal, Spirit Form turns on by itself and leaves you with 1 health point. It works only if you have enough hunger. It triggers once: if you leave the form and take damage again, you die. It can also be toggled on the passive wheel. Soul Shards need it enabled.
screen.spirit_form.instinct.cost: One trigger costs hunger marks: %s (value set in the config).
screen.spirit_form.souls.name: Army of the Beyond
screen.spirit_form.souls.desc: When enabled, enemies you slay may drop souls that join your Army of the Beyond. When disabled, no souls drop from slain enemies. Souls already in your Army are kept. The Scythe of the Beyond charge does not depend on this.
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.name: Spirit Form
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.desc: Spirit Form grows gradually: each level adds a new power. Everything else (translucent look, Darkness, night vision and so on) works from level 1.
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.l1: 1. Form unlocked. Immunity to fall damage.
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.l2: 2. Passing through blocks. Double-tap Shift to toggle it. Without flying you stand on surfaces; hold Shift to pass through them.
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.l3: 3. Flight. Double-tap Space to toggle it.
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.mode_full: Overworld mode: all levels are already unlocked.
message.spirit_form.form.reset: Spirit Form reset to level 1. Experience levels refunded: %s.
message.spirit_form.form.full_mode: Overworld mode is on: the form is already at maximum.
gamerule.spiritFormOverworldMode.descrip: When on, the Spirit Form ability is at maximum from the start: flight, passing through blocks and invulnerability. When off (default, Beyond mode), it is upgraded level by level.
spirit_form.configuration.formCostLevel2: Experience levels charged for level 2 of the Spirit Form ability.
spirit_form.configuration.formCostLevel3: Experience levels charged for level 3 of the Spirit Form ability.
spirit_form.configuration.formCostLevel4: Experience levels charged for level 4 of the Spirit Form ability.
tooltip.spirit_form.gloves.1: Blocks break at normal speed while flying. Works in a hand or in a vault cell.
screen.spirit_form.formlevel.invuln.off: Invulnerability: off (only fall damage immunity remains).
tooltip.spirit_form.soul_pull.1: Items and experience within %s blocks fly to the wearer. Worn as boots or placed in the vault.
tooltip.spirit_form.soul_memory.1: Restores durability of armor, items in hand and items in the vault's gear cells every second.
tooltip.spirit_form.soul_memory.2: Works in a hand or in a vault cell. It has durability; repair it with a Crystallized Soul.
spirit_form.configuration.soulPullRadius: Radius in blocks within which Soul Pull draws items and experience.
spirit_form.configuration.soulMemoryRepa: Durability points restored each second on every damaged piece.
spirit_form.configuration.soulMemoryPoin: How many durability points Soul Memory restores in total for each point of its own durability.
screen.spirit_form.wheel.page_hint: Left click the centre - next · right click the centre - previous
ability.spirit_form.self_sufficiency.des: Opens a wheel of stations: crafting table, furnace, enchanting table and more. Launched from the ability bar (%s).
screen.spirit_form.station.page_buy: Shift+click: unlock the page for %s lvl
screen.spirit_form.station.hint: Click - open · Shift+click - buy · Right click - close
message.spirit_form.station.need_page: Unlock a new station page first
message.spirit_form.station.unstable: This station previously kicked you from the world. Shift+click it to try again
message.spirit_form.station.no_room: No free space nearby to open the station
message.spirit_form.station.external_fai: The station did not open: this block has no window or is not supported
Blocks from other mods that become Self-Sufficiency stations (up to 8): a block id, optionally followed by | and an item id for the icon. Restart the game after changing it.
screen.spirit_form.external.empty: Empty cell: place a station block from another mod or an Akashic Chronicles book here
screen.spirit_form.external.hint: Click a block (or an Akashic Chronicles book) in your inventory, then a cell. Shift+click puts it in the first free cell. Clicking an occupied cell returns the item.
screen.spirit_form.external.desc: The block in this cell becomes a Self-Sufficiency station: open the station wheel, put it in the loadout (Placement menu) and buy it like the rest. Its window opens as if you clicked the block itself. Such a station does not work in the background. Removing a station returns its contents to you.
message.spirit_form.station.not_block: This is neither a block nor an Akashic Chronicles book
message.spirit_form.station.ext_full: All external station cells are taken
screen.spirit_form.souls.title: Soul Improvement
screen.spirit_form.souls.empty: The army storage has no souls. Collect them from mint smoke after kills.
screen.spirit_form.souls.rank_tip: Rank grows from kills made by this very soul: first health doubles, then damage, then speed by half as much again, and the fourth promotion doubles health and damage again.
screen.spirit_form.souls.maxed: This stat is at its highest level
screen.spirit_form.souls.hint: Click an armor piece in your inventory, then a slot. Shift+click equips at once, clicking a slot removes it. Right click goes back.
message.spirit_form.army.need_lord: Only the Lord of the Beyond can improve souls
message.spirit_form.army.maxed: This stat is already at its highest level
message.spirit_form.disguise.stolen: You took the appearance of: %s. Hold Delirium for 5 seconds to take it off or put it on again.
message.spirit_form.disguise.off: You returned to your own appearance
screen.spirit_form.bar.station.desc: Stations of the Self-Sufficiency wheel: three pages of four. Stations can be rearranged even before they are bought.
spirit_form.configuration.stationPage2Co: Experience levels charged for the second page of the station wheel.
spirit_form.configuration.stationPage3Co: Experience levels charged for the third page of the station wheel.
command.spirit_form.shard.none: There is no Soul Shard to return.
command.spirit_form.shard.exists: Your Soul Shard still exists: %s %s %s (%s). Use Spirit Sense, its trail of smoke leads to it.
command.spirit_form.shard.failed: Could not return the Soul Shard.
command.spirit_form.shard.done: Soul Shard returned. Take your things from it.
command.spirit_form.locate.volcano: Nearest Titanic Volcano: %s, %s blocks away. It exists only in chunks generated after the update.
message.spirit_form.klunnyk.frown: The Klunnyk frowns: he dislikes you freezing his lake.
message.spirit_form.klunnyk.angry: The Klunnyk is furious: his heat burns you and your belongings!
message.spirit_form.klunnyk.refuse: The Klunnyk turns away: coal will not soothe him. He likes golden apples.
message.spirit_form.klunnyk.full: The Klunnyk already thanked you. Give him some time.
message.spirit_form.bahatko.lured: The fire has lured a Bahatko: sparks appear beside you!
message.spirit_form.phoenix.ride_hot: The Phoenix's wings scorch the rider like a magma block. Enable Icy Touch to avoid burning.
message.spirit_form.perun.noticed: Perun, God of the Sky, has noticed you.
message.spirit_form.perun.begins: Wrath of God: Perun hunts you under the open sky of the Heatland while you carry a Phoenix feather.
message.spirit_form.perun.ends: The Wrath of God has passed.
message.spirit_form.phoenix.untameable: A wild Phoenix cannot be tamed. Only one reborn from Ash.
message.spirit_form.phoenix.hungry: The Phoenix is hungry and will not let you near. Feed it blaze powder, magma cream, a blaze rod or an ember.
message.spirit_form.phoenix.hungry_soon: The Phoenix is getting hungry: feed it, or it will fly back to the volcano.
message.spirit_form.phoenix_ash.needs_la: The Ash only awakens next to lava.
message.spirit_form.phoenix_ash.begins: The Ash stirs. In 3 minutes a Phoenix will rise from it.
OVERWORLD: everything works as usual. NETHER: the Spirit Form comes only with death, and leaving a possessed mob returns the human form. BEYOND: the spirit takes damage, and outside the Beyond the form lasts only one minute.
message.spirit_form.nether.locked: In the Nether you cannot become a spirit at will: the form comes only with death.
message.spirit_form.nether.stay: A Nether spirit cannot leave the form. Possess a mob and exit it.
message.spirit_form.nether.returned: The mob gave its life and you are human again. The form returns only after your next death.
message.spirit_form.nether.reborn: You died and were reborn as a spirit. Possess a mob to regain your human shape.
message.spirit_form.beyond.warning: The form fades in 10 seconds. Only in the Beyond does it last without limit.
message.spirit_form.beyond.timeout: The form faded: outside the Beyond it lasts only a minute.
